svg.aria-label: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash Routed experts plus a separate shared expert schematic
svg.title: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash — Routed experts plus a separate shared expert
svg.desc: Correction bias chooses routed experts; unbiased scores weight their outputs. The shared expert runs independently of routed top-k. Unfused PyTorch reference adapted from DeepSeek-AI (MIT). Text-only sqrt-softplus routing, normalized routed top-k greater than one, and one shared expert. Dimensions and numerical settings come from V41Config. CPU float32, bfloat16 and backward behavior are tested. No image routing bias, quantization, expert parallelism, checkpoint loading, GPU certification or throughput claim.
